distinguishing_features: High-gradient magnetic separation applied directly to a molten plastic melt stream rather than to an aqueous or gas medium
Non-contact capture driven by magnetic gradient force exceeding melt viscous drag, eliminating physical screen contact
Continuous self-cleaning contaminant extraction via rotating magnetic conveyor without screen replacement
Targets metal/label contaminants by magnetic susceptibility independent of plastic stickiness to break the clogging failure mode
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Remove ferrous/metal contaminants from a viscous recycled plastic melt continuously without the progressive clogging and frequent screen replacement burden of physical screening or magnetic interception in contact with the melt.
parsed.viable_reason: HGMS force magnitudes exceed viscous drag for ferrous particles at stated field, is testable with the given pass/fail protocol, and targets the clogging failure mode with a physically plausible non-contact channel.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Applying high-gradient magnetic separation to a hot, highly viscous polymer melt as a non-contact, self-cleaning replacement for clogging screens is not a routine extension of prior-art monitoring or aqueous HGMS practice.
